The free daily momentum slot was considered, but there is no cleaner second setup than the existing thesis trade: Binance is still bullish_short_term and BTC is holding near the highs, yet 79k REACH Yes is only around 0.115 and would be a fresh second-leg chase after much of the immediate rebound has already played out. On the bearish side, 76k DIP Yes has weakened to about 0.185 and still fights both the live move and the active bearish-bias-correction rule. With the main valid setup already open and no justified management or secondary entry, the correct decision is NO_ACTION.
